messages:
jules: noticed a PEM block printed in a CI artifact for reranker-service (ap-south). saw full client cert + private key. attaching brief snippet (sanitized)

jules: ```
[ci-build] cat build.log | tail -n 50
...
--- CLIENT CERT BEGIN ---
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEvQIBADANBgkq...
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIID...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
--- CLIENT CERT END ---
```

harper: damn. immediate actions: 1) mark incident and page oncall 2) revoke cert/issue short TTL replacement 3) rotate KMS wrapping key 4) remove CI SA access to KMS unwrap 5) scan for exfil via audit logs

oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-5901 "reranker-service CI PEM exposure (ap-south)". Assigned: harper, li. Severity: P2.

li: i'll start the CA revoke now and generate a replacement cert with ttl=12h. we should treat the private key as compromised until proven otherwise.

li: CA revoke command: ```
cactl revoke --serial 0x9ab3c --reason keyCompromise --issuer reranker-ca-ap-south
```

rotator-bot: Recommend flow: create new KMS key version, rewrap artifacts, update config secretref, and run a canary handshake against ap-south proxy pool. Emitting audit tag "rotator:reranker-ci" for all ops.

harper: removing kms:Decrypt/kms:Unwrap privileges from `ci-build@bots` in ap-south immediately. creating a short-lived role for `ci-build` that forbids key unwrap.

harper: IAM patch (ap-south): ```
- members: ["serviceAccount:ci-build@bots"]
  role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterOnly
  condition: null
```

harper: new binding for rotator: ```
- members: ["serviceAccount:rotator@infra"]
  role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
  condition: {title: "limit-to-reranker", expression: "resource.name.endsWith('/cryptoKeys/reranker-key')"}
```

li: rewrap step executed: ```
kmsctl new-version --key reranker-key --region ap-south && kmsctl rewrap --key old-version --new-key new-version --resource secrets/reranker/ci --tag rotator:reranker-ci
```

jules: proxy caches worry me. ap-south edge has long-lived session tickets. recommend issuing proxy purge + set ephemeral session_ticket_lifetime=20s during rollout.

harper: proxy purge API (ap-south): ```
curl -X POST "https://proxy-api.internal/ap-south/purge" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROXY_TOKEN" -d '{"service":"reranker-service","targets":["clients","edge"]}'
```

li: CA revoke returned success. new cert issued. rotator logs: ```
[2026-04-02T09:12:05Z] rotator:reranker-ci created new-kv v3
[2026-04-02T09:12:19Z] rotator:reranker-ci rewrap success
[2026-04-02T09:12:43Z] cactl revoke serial 0x9ab3c success
```

jules: running SIEM search for any external fetches of the old key material in last 14 days. code: ```
siem query "resource.type:storage AND message:('-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----' OR 'reranker-key') AND timestamp > '2026-03-19'"
```

jules: prelim results: only reads from internal CI instance ids. no unknown IPs. forwarding full output to incident ticket.

harper: added infra PR to harden CI logs: redact PEM-like patterns in build logs and fail builds if private key found. PR: #infra/ci-log-redact. snippet: ```
if grep -q -E "-----BEGIN (PRIVATE KEY|CERTIFICATE)-----" build.log; then echo "sensitive data found"; exit 1; fi
```

rotator-bot: Recommended follow-ups: - increase kms.rewrap audit retention to 3y - add automated cross-region mTLS smoke test that runs post-rotation - implement time-limited emergency rotation role (rotator-bypass) with short TTL tokens - add alert on any KMS unwrap from CI accounts

li: scheduled canary handshake tests across ap-south -> us-central and ap-south -> eu-west. smoke test command: ```
smoketest tls-handshake --service reranker-service --from ap-south --to proxy --expect mTLS
```

harper: rolled PR to remove unwrap perms and bound rotator role. CI logs redaction staged. created postmortem doc and ETA for completed mitigations: 48h.

jules: thanks team. closing slack thread, keeping incident open until 24h quiet period.
